name: cull-mesh
description: Post-meshify CPU cull: drop low-confidence (few-view), distant (sky/far), sub-floor, out-of-camera-bbox, and out-of-primitive-solid vertices from an already-materialized mesh. Path-agnostic (matcha tetra/tsdf + da3). Consumes the upstream mesh node's grounded mesh.ply (canonical gauge preserved); NOOP when the identity exists; no GPU. NEW ADDITIVE TASK — does NOT touch meshify-via-tsdf/tetra identities. @1 (STO-SCN-137) adds cambox_expand; @2 (STO-SCN-145) adds the `primitives` boolean-SDF cull — each version bumped because the prior version already had materialized nodes (adding a key would re-key them); prior-version nodes are preserved untouched (see STO-SCN-136 backwards-compat).

min_views.note: drop verts seen by < N cameras (low-parallax distant junk); matches cull_mesh.py default

max_dist_from_cluster.note: drop verts > D m from camera centroid (the sky/far-away killer); 0 = disabled (default)

cambox_expand.note: STO-SCN-137: keep verts inside the posed-camera AABB expanded by this fraction per side, cull outside (gravity-aligned); <0 = disabled (default)

floor_z_min.note: drop verts with z < this in the oriented gauge (sub-floor tetra spikes); floor is z=0

primitives.note: STO-SCN-145: boolean cull primitives (sphere/box/cylinder/halfspace, op keep|subtract) authored in the datum frame (meters); keep verts inside the resulting solid. The inline spec content enters the identity. null = disabled (default).

image_size.note: WxH for the in-bounds view-count projection; matches the solve frame
